notes.title: GatePass Update ver2.0.0
notes.content:
[h3]GatePass Update - Making the Game More Accessible![/h3]
I've added many features to improve the gameplay experience!
Simply put, my goal is to make "a game that's easy to play even if you're not great at action or puzzle games."
Here are the details of the latest update:
--------------------------------------------------
Update Summary
① Added extra HP for Knot in boss battles (up to 12)
② Added full-room camera switching feature
③ Implemented Coyote Time
④ Added key configuration feature
⑤ Relaxed portal room unlock conditions
⑥ Added event skip feature
⑦ Updated to Unity 6
⑧ Added 10 new Steam achievements
⑨ Adjusted difficulty for various stages

[previewyoutube=TlzbbD5Lrwg;full][/previewyoutube]

--------------------------------------------------
I've also posted a video explanation on Twitter (X) with the same update details.

[url=https://x.com/necoroneko/status/1899805080200847434]Twitter（X) Post[/url]

Now, let’s go through each feature in detail.
--------------------------------------------------
[h3]① Extra HP for Knot in Boss Battles (Up to 12)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/f1c442ea7ce84197373aa1cee66919eeb24f6462.png[/img]

By default, Knot starts with 3 HP. However, every time you lose a battle, your starting HP increases.
This allows players who struggle with action games to eventually defeat the boss through persistence.
Currently, for every 5 deaths, Knot's max HP increases by 1, up to a maximum of 12.

For players who want a challenge (or aim for achievements), there is also an option to keep Knot's HP permanently at 1.
--------------------------------------------------
[h3]② Full-Room Camera Switching[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/8f3a9655601d716e281c79c32b110fb9e5a6cb09.png[/img]

In stages with multiple rooms, you can now switch the camera view instantly to see different rooms.
This feature is helpful for strategizing your approach.

The camera switching operates independently of the pause menu.

Camera switching is assigned to the left and right keys, while pause menu navigation is assigned to the up and down keys.
--------------------------------------------------
[h3]③ Implemented Coyote Time[/h3]
Coyote Time is a mechanic that allows players to jump for a brief moment after stepping off a ledge.

In GatePass, if you fall off a ledge but press jump within 10 frames (1 tile's distance), the game will count it as a ground jump.

Many 2D action games reset your position if you mistime a jump by even a single frame, which can be frustrating.

This feature helps prevent such frustrations, making the game smoother for players unfamiliar with action games.
--------------------------------------------------
[h3]④ Key Configuration Feature[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/a77d1b15bdbc2a044970e55c9a5a72edab3d883e.png[/img]

You can now customize key bindings for both controllers and keyboards.

Additionally, in the tutorial signs at the beginning of the game, the displayed instructions change dynamically based on whether you are using a keyboard or controller.
--------------------------------------------------
[h3]⑤ Relaxed Portal Room Unlock Conditions[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/02099d436fa7d6d2527f5660c1bc16e144d4ca52.png[/img]

In the old version, you had to clear each stage one by one to progress.

In ver 2.0.0, I have increased the number of initially unlocked rooms.
By the mid-game, players will have around 4-5 rooms per world to choose from, with up to 20 stages available at once.

At the start of the game, only tutorial stages are required to be cleared in sequence.
In ver 1.1.4, I unlocked all 100 stages, but many players found this overwhelming, so I adjusted the system.

If you've been playing the older version and have progressed far beyond the required stages, your available rooms will be relocked according to the ver 2.0.0 system. Please be aware of this change.
--------------------------------------------------
[h3]⑥ Added Event Skip Feature[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/5b61cadeb7b3d1ffe2545b7c5b90ba47241d0261.png[/img]

During cutscenes, you can now skip the event by clicking the skip button in the bottom right corner of the screen.

This applies to:

Title screen intro (20 sec)
New game intro movie (126 sec)
Various endings (66 sec, 80 sec)
Credit sequences (86 sec, 217 sec)
--------------------------------------------------
[h3]⑦ Updated to Unity 6[/h3]
GatePass has been updated to Unity 6000.0.41f1.

This update removes the Unity logo at startup, reducing the game’s launch time by a few seconds.
It also improves loading speeds when transitioning between stages.

Due to the engine update, the credits have been revised to reflect the new software version.
(The previous version used Unity 2020.1.3f1.)
--------------------------------------------------
[h3]⑧ Added 10 New Steam Achievements[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/fdbb89caf339ed15add28b8c8f464e0b38297c33.png[/img]

These new achievements fall into two categories:

・Defeating each boss without taking damage
・Clearing the stage immediately before each boss

To assist with the no-damage boss achievements, you can set Knot’s HP to 1 at all times via the options menu.

For the pre-boss stage achievements, you need to clear the stage without skipping to earn them.
--------------------------------------------------
[h3]⑨ Adjusted Difficulty for Various Stages[/h3]
Here are some key adjustments:

Sign08 & Sign15: Removed time limits on certain boxes.

Sign15, Conv14, Conv15: Changed tile colors for better room distinction when using camera switching.

Lay10: Adjusted the final sign’s position for easier navigation.

Lay11: Shortened a long hallway by 1 tile for smoother movement.

Lay15: Increased the height of the central platform’s ceiling by 1 tile for easier dodging.

Lay18: Reduced enemy count by 2 in the first room and repositioned some signs to improve bullet dodging.

Miki Boss Fight: Reduced falling bullet count by 30%.

Sub Boss Fight: Reduced the third phase's horizontal bullet waves by 40%.

Zept Boss Fight:
Reduced "Striped Thunder" attacks from 10 to 5 times.
Reduced targeted thunder attacks from 10 to 5-7 times.
Delayed lightning and tile-breaking attacks by 10 frames for better dodge timing.
Reduced falling sign count by 50% during "Striped Thunder" attack.

Ray Boss Fight: Adjusted angle and size of meteors in "Meteor Dunk" for easier dodging.
--------------------------------------------------
[h3]⑩ Future Updates[/h3]
I regularly review live streams and archives of GatePass to find areas for improvement.
Additionally, I plan to:

Add hints for difficult stages (like a treasure map system).

Introduce a hidden stage and achievement to make the completion rate 101% instead of 100%.
I’ll keep you updated once these features are implemented!
--------------------------------------------------
[h3]⑪ Final Comments[/h3]
I've worked hard to make the game more accessible, but as a solo developer, this was extremely exhausting.

Implementing key configuration was particularly difficult, but I managed to complete it.

On top of this, given the sheer amount of work I’ve done, the current price is honestly too low.
For example, just Adobe’s annual subscription (~$570) already puts me in the red.

I am considering raising the price after the sale period ends.

I hope my efforts pay off, and more people discover and play GatePass!
Thank you so much for your support! 🙏

notes.title: ver1.1.3 Update
notes.content:
I thank the many people who play and broadcast live every day.

I have made some changes to the stage layout in Sign20 to make it easier to get through by the regular route. After watching 5 of the live broadcasts, I felt that some of the pathways were unnecessarily difficult, so I have widened the pathways and changed the length of the pathways.

Also, I have enabled the cloud save setting in this version, so if you run GatePass from another PC across Windows, the save data will be shared.
The same setting is also shared between Macs, but the data is not shared between Windows and Macs or other different OS. Please understand this in advance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/97ffa3201b287c6f7d08ed27f28d282ad4fce9bd.png[/img]

notes.title: ver1.1.2 Update
notes.content:
I thank the many people who play and broadcast live every day.

In the new version, we have numbered each stage of the portal room.
This will allow you to determine the number of stages at a glance without having to follow it with your eyes.
I have also added a stage symbol on the wall of each room.
These are also displayed in an easy-to-understand manner in accordance with the concept of each stage.

In addition, code changes have been made to eliminate some bugs in the internal system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/ad167ee0fe42f425decdd942990551e099c5c944.png[/img]

notes.title: Windows ver1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
Thank you to the many people who play and broadcast live every day.

I have updated the following three points in the new version.

No.1: Many live players seemed to feel that the residual time of the bomb blast was too long in the Zepto battle, so we have shortened the residual time of the blast by about 0.5 seconds. This is applied to each type of bomb, large and small.
I have made the decision easier for both the first round and the rematch against Zepto.

No.2: Some broadcasters said that the third form of the hexagonal barrage in the battle against Rey was difficult to locate at certain angles. The author verified this and eliminated 4 patterns that were difficult to avoid. This boss is also being re-set in the first round and in the rematch.

No.3: The placement of some objects was slightly changed in Conv 10. I have received feedback from several live broadcasts that the solution was not clear despite the regular route, so we have tried to be flexible with the placement.

Live broadcasts and play-by-play submissions remain welcome.
I appreciate the opportunity to receive feedback and will continue to update the site.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/1a194d324b17c3fafe38c1e36433827c81a35528.png[/img]

notes.title: WIndows ver1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
I thank the many people who play and broadcast live every day.

I have reduced the conveyor hauling speed by 66% in Conv14 and Conv15.
This makes it incredibly easy compared to the old version.
If you were getting stuck in the action element of this room, please give it a try.

Note that the conveyor speed is still applied to the player as usual.
In these two rooms, only the doors move very slowly. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/df9ca78781c0946712f3f1d80fd93558ffa29e7c.png[/img].

notes.title: Winfows ver1.0.8 Update
notes.content:
Thank you to the many people who play and live stream the game every day.
We have responded to your requests for additional Steam Achievements.

Six more Steam Achievements have been added.
If you already have saved data that satisfies the predefined conditions, the achievements will be automatically completed the next time you start the game.

The achievements are as follows

Welcome to GatePass (Achieved by clearing the first room)
Acoustic Hygienist (Achieved by defeating Miki)
Guardian of locks (Achieved after defeating Cheddar)
Sign administrator (Achieved by defeating the sub)
Carnivorous Herbivore (Achieved by defeating Zepto)
Star Observers (achieved by defeating Ray)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/695c7d53bef14dfff767a0d170029cd9c268cb80.png[/img]

Due to the large number of system settings, only languages with a large user base are supported for translation of the achievements.
Some achievements are displayed in English. Please understand this.

Updates for the Mac version will be compiled at a later date. Please wait for a while.

notes.title: Windows ver1.0.7 Update
notes.content:
I have made the needles that fall during the transition from the second to the third form in the Sub fight into a background with default settings.
When I checked the play videos of people who played the game, it looked like they were struggling a lot, so we are easing it up.
When the author checked the operation of the game, it was made so easy that the level felt easier than any of the bosses.
It is an easy difficulty for those who understand the system of the stage. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/8cf0da1c700e61158998e9c1b882d4f67a8755fe.png[/img]

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

notes.title: Windows ver1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
No.1: In Conv14 and Conv15, the wall of the bottom passageway has been extended by one tile square to the left and right.
This lengthens the flow line of the gate or hall on the conveyor, allowing for more room for player manipulation.

No.2: Regarding the internal system, unnecessary Event System objects have been removed from all scenes. This is intended to reduce the weight of the game. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/4755573c76d102ff075f0b130a2646bb25d91e94.png[/img]

notes.title: Windows ver1.0.5 update
notes.content:
The following stages have been placed and modified to ease the difficulty of the action

Box 13: The time limit box has been changed to a regular box. The box is placed in front of the key.
Sign08: Multiple objects such as signs and doors in the initial room have been shifted slightly closer to the passageway to aim for shorter movement times.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45223520/75f5dc475538aa75771b028f7bbf326f167b7136.png[/img]

notes.title: Added option to change screen size (Winsows/Mac)
notes.content:
Added option to change screen size (Winsows/Mac)

You can choose from 5 different sizes
800x450
1024x576
1280x720
1600x900
Full screen

If the window is not in full screen, you can change the window location by dragging the mouse, etc.

Other changes 1:
The hit point of the body hit of the Key stage boss was made a little smaller.

Other change 2:
A buzzer sound is now emitted when a box cannot be thrown with the up key.
Boxes cannot be thrown if they are too close to a wall or if they hit the ceiling.
